reading.frozen_statement: The paper must say that turnover and controller dependence largely reflect generic trajectory sensitivity of the closed loop rather than precision-specific effects.

reading_a1.defensible_statement: A higher bit width is not necessary for two-sided flips and controller dependence; they also appear when only the W3 calibration checkpoint is swapped (d1 → d2): r′ 8.2, d′ 9.0, M′ 17.3 pp of units, off-diagonal′ 27.6% of divergent states.
reading_a1.statement: A higher bit width is not necessary for two-sided flips and controller dependence; they also appear when only the W3 calibration checkpoint is swapped (d1 → d2): r′ 8.2, d′ 9.0, M′ 17.3 pp of units, off-diagonal′ 27.6% of divergent states. No precision-specific excess in turnover was detected (ΔM +1.6 pp), but equivalence at ±3 pp is not shown (90% CI [+0.05, +3.08], TOST p = 0.055); the paper must not call the designs similar or the turnover not precision-specific.
